about: What Settings › AI starts with until the person sets their own (<config>/assist/settings.json). The presets are Settings › AI › Connection's choices, templates the person edits under Advanced; nothing is probed or detected. An Anthropic preset with an empty model takes the default model of assist.json; for another, the person names the model. Keys are never in this file or the person's: they live in the system keychain under the endpoint's base URL.

endpoint_presets.title: A model on this computer (Ollama, LM Studio…)

sources.permissions: The founder's defaults for agents (docs/design/extension-abi-design.md): edits run inside the reviewable turn, which undoes as one step; files and publishing to a library ask; the built-in chat moves the view without asking (founder, 14 November: view steering is on for the built-in agent). Publishing a part into the open project never asks (founder, 16 November). Each ask offers Allow once, Allow for this session, Always allow and Deny.
sources.limits_start: Limits are unset by default and the shipped workflows declare no budget, so a run goes on until it is done (founder, 16, 22 and 24 November). These are only the values the limits start from when the person turns them on: docs/assistant-panel.md §6.3, 40 model requests, 200 000 output tokens and 4 000 000 tokens as approved on 9 November, 45 minutes as approved in Q7. There are no per-turn caps on edits or calls.
sources.endpoint_presets: The choices of Settings › AI › Connection, in this order, titled in plain words (founder, 16 November: no jargon on the first screen). Anthropic's API base URL; OpenAI's API base URL, https://api.openai.com/v1 (OpenAI's API reference); Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint on its default port 11434 (the person changes it for LM Studio, llama-server or another server under Advanced). OpenAI names no model here: its model ids change often, so the person types the one they use. The context is a starting value the person corrects to what their server gives the model; tool calling is declared on, vision and PDF reading off until the person declares them. timeout_minutes is how long the model may send nothing before a request is given up, and never limits a reply that keeps arriving (founder, 24 November): 30 minutes for a hosted model; 90 for one on this computer, which at 17 tokens a second takes 31 minutes for 32 000 output tokens it does not stream.
sources.network: Seconds each kind of request may hear nothing before it is given up; the person changes each in Settings › Network, where "No limit" is a choice (founder, 24 November). The values the requests had as limits in code before: 4 for a search of the online library (it then answers from the last index), 30 for its index, 60 for a part's data, 10 for the account, 5 for telling the registry of a sign-out, 120 for counting a prompt's tokens, 60 for Test connection.
sources.agent_presets: The ACP launch commands each agent documents: claude-agent-acp, codex-acp, gemini --acp, opencode acp. Titles name the agent only; the command shows under Advanced.
